label: Extracellular matrix, collagen and basement membrane
reason: Collagen synthesis/crosslinking, elastic fibres, laminin/integrin and hemidesmosome assembly all build ECM; arylsulfatase is a lone outlier.

label: Mechanoresponsive fibroblast adhesion and migration
reason: YAP/TAZ matricellular programmes, focal adhesion, fibronectin matrix, integrins, EMT and fibroblast migration form one stromal adhesion theme.

label: DNA repair and telomere maintenance
reason: BER, NER, MMR, HR/NHEJ, TLS, Fanconi and telomere maintenance are all genome maintenance; few odd transcription/editosome terms.

label: Cilium assembly, trafficking and motility
reason: IFT, BBSome cargo targeting, axonemal dynein arms, sperm flagella and ciliary motility processes are all cilia biology.

label: Heart development and morphogenesis
reason: Heart field specification, septation, ventricle and atrial morphogenesis and cardiomyocyte differentiation; TFAP2 is the only marginal member.

label: Viral attachment and entry into host
reason: Dengue, RSV, influenza, HIV and SARS attachment, entry, fusion and virus-host junction targeting share the viral entry theme.

label: Nuclear steroid and thyroid hormone receptor signalling
reason: Estrogen, androgen, progesterone and thyroid receptor signalling plus HSP90 and SUMO regulation of nuclear receptors.

label: Catecholamine neurotransmitter transport and reuptake
reason: Dopamine/norepinephrine uptake, SLC6A2/SLC6A3 defects and vesicular loading are all monoamine transport.

label: Golgi and endosome vesicular trafficking
reason: COPI traffic, intra-Golgi, TGN retrograde, endosome-to-Golgi and Golgi-to-lysosome transport form one membrane traffic theme.

label: Folate one-carbon and methionine metabolism
reason: Folate interconversion, SAM/methionine cycle, salvage and MTR/MTRR/MAT1A/AHCY defects; neural tube closure is folate-linked.

label: HIV replication and APOBEC cytidine deaminase restriction
reason: HIV entry, reverse transcription and integration joined with APOBEC3G-mediated cytidine deamination restriction and Vif counteraction; APOBEC1 editosome via deamination.

label: Neuroendocrine control of feeding and GH secretion
reason: Feeding behaviour and ghrelin linked to growth hormone/prolactin secretion via ghrelin and somatostatin/peptide GPCR hormone axis.

label: Chemokine-driven leukocyte migration and lymphoid tissue
reason: Chemokine receptors, DC/T/B/NK chemotaxis, lymphocyte homing and lymph node/MALT development; a few mesenchymal/astrocyte outliers.

label: Lipid droplet and triglyceride storage
reason: Lipid droplet formation, fusion, disassembly, lipophagy and triglyceride storage regulation, plus adipocyte leptin module.

label: Miscellaneous metabolism and solute transport
reason: Sample spans glycosylation, steroids, electron transport, ion transport, heme, erythropoiesis, clock genes and influenza apoptosis with no shared theme.

label: Eye development and retinal vasculature
reason: Lens, retina, cornea, optic cup and retinal vessel/blood-retinal barrier (Norrin-FZD4) development; gap junction and D/V axis are marginal.

label: Myelination and glial biology
reason: CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, oligodendrocyte progenitors, Schwann cell myelination, gliosis and axon calibre.

label: Axon guidance signalling
reason: Netrin/DCC, SLIT/ROBO, ephrin, L1 and Rac/Cdc42 guidance cues for commissural axon pathfinding.

label: Transition metal ion homeostasis and detoxification
reason: Zinc, iron, copper, manganese, cadmium transport, metallothioneins, heme scavenging and transferrin cycling.

label: Phospholipid and sphingolipid transfer and metabolism
reason: Intermembrane lipid transfer, glycolipid/ceramide transport, PI/PC synthesis and lysophospholipid hydrolysis.

label: Translation initiation and ribosome quality control
reason: Cap-dependent initiation, 43S/eIF2 cycle, elongation/termination with ribosome rescue, no-go decay and NMD coupled to translation.

label: ER protein targeting, folding and export
reason: SRP and tail-anchored insertion, ER folding/quality control, ERAD, COPII cargo loading and ER-Golgi transport.

label: Epidermis and skin appendage development
reason: Keratinocyte proliferation/differentiation, hair follicle cycling, nail, sebaceous gland and melanocyte development in skin.

label: Axon guidance signalling
reason: SLIT/ROBO, netrin, ephrin, L1/CHL1 and Rac/Rho cytoskeletal guidance of commissural axons.

label: Leptin, ghrelin and growth hormone energy balance
reason: Appetite/feeding regulation joined with GH receptor signalling and organism growth via ghrelin-GH axis and shared JAK2-STAT leptin/GH signalling.

label: Platelet activation and blood coagulation
reason: Coagulation cascade and factor defects, vitamin K gamma-carboxylation, platelet adhesion/activation and fibrinolysis; IGFBP is an outlier.

label: Eicosanoid and specialized pro-resolving lipid mediators
reason: Leukotrienes, lipoxins, resolvins, protectins, maresins, hepoxilins and EET synthesis from PUFAs.

label: Glutamate, ammonia and urea cycle nitrogen metabolism
reason: Glutamate/glutamine, aspartate, proline, ornithine/arginine metabolism and ammonium homeostasis.

label: Skin keratinization and melanocyte pigmentation
reason: Keratinocyte cornification/barrier and MITF-driven melanocyte pigmentation linked as cooperating epidermal cell types of skin.

label: Nuclear RNA transcription and processing
reason: Pol I/III transcription, rRNA processing, snRNP assembly, splicing, 3'-end processing and nuclear RNA surveillance; MYC targets fit biogenesis.

label: Drug reward and dopaminergic/opioid signalling
reason: Cocaine, amphetamine and ethanol responses, conditioned preference, DARPP-32, opioid and neuropeptide GPCR signalling.

label: Axon guidance and repulsion
reason: Netrin, SLIT/ROBO, ephrin, semaphorin, DSCAM and L1 guidance with growth cone cytoskeletal control.

label: Skeletal muscle contraction, growth and adaptation
reason: Sarcomere filament assembly, contraction, myogenesis, regeneration, atrophy and calcineurin-NFAT signalling; dendrite/netrin terms are outliers.

label: mRNA stability, decay and stress granules
reason: AU-rich element binding proteins, deadenylation, decapping, stress granule and P-body assembly and translational repression.

label: Myeloid and granulocyte differentiation
reason: Granulopoiesis, G-CSF signalling, RUNX regulation of myeloid differentiation and promyelocyte granule protein modules.

label: Base excision repair and active DNA demethylation
reason: Glycosylase-initiated BER and alkylation reversal; TET/TDG demethylation proceeds through BER, so one mechanism.

label: Striated muscle hypertrophy and atrophy adaptation
reason: Cardiac and skeletal muscle size regulation, fibre-type switching and calcineurin-NFAT-driven adaptation.

label: Synapse assembly and plasticity
reason: Neurexin/neuroligin adhesion, receptor clustering, PSD organisation, dendritic spine regulation and LTP/LTD.

label: Broad signalling, immunity and miscellany
reason: Sample spans kinase-inhibitor resistant mutants, interferon, B cell, fibroblast, lipid mediator and skin defect terms with no common theme.

label: Adrenal corticosteroid synthesis and HPA axis
reason: Glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid biosynthesis/secretion, ACTH/corticotropin control and cortisol responses.
